title: cespedesia scandens

It is a woody vine native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Cespedesia scandens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
